newsitem.title: USA: Amtech to take big charges to sell WaveNet.
newsitem.headline: Amtech to take big charges to sell WaveNet.

text.p: Amtech Corp said Thursday it would take "significant charges" for the planned sale of its WaveNet Inc subsidiary and its laying off 36 people at WaveNet's offices in Mississauga, Ontario, and Atlanta.

"The company expects significant one-time charges in connection with the disposition of WaveNet, although future operating results and cash flow of Amtech will be enhanced significantly as a result of this action," said chief financial officer Steve York in a statement.

Amtech said it is looking for buyers for WaveNet, a wireless local area network (LAN) terminal provider. The company said it is laying off 34 employees, some of whom it will offer transfers to other business units, pending WaveNet's sale.

"We determined that it would take substantial additional capital resources to quickly attain critical mass in the wireless LAN terminal market in the wake of ongoing consolidation of the industry's established competitors," said chief executive Russell Mortenson in a statement.

He added the company would channel its resources into its transportation systems group and the electronic security group "in light of their growing working capital needs, occasioned by the company's current all-time record order backlog."
Company officials were unavailable to elaborate on the restructuring.
Amtech's stock traded unchanged at 4-11/16 Friday.
